headline.text: Three foreign-material events at L1 and L3 — tape in chocolate, glycol in depositor, *grease on product* — all caught and cleared.

summary: One active hold at L1 S3 for wrong decoration pattern (resolved same day). Three foreign-material events required investigation: tape in L1 S3 decorator tank (removed, oil-flushed), glycol leak into L3 ML1 hopper (purged clean), and grease on two L3 ML1 chocolate bars (isolated). L1 S2 monitoring dark substance from melting tank shaft — maintenance believes chocolate, not oil.

holds.title: Wrong decoration pattern on PRS Brookies
holds.summary: Incorrect drizzle pattern used from start of run; all product from beginning of run placed on hold pending line clearance and pattern correction.
holds.status: Resolved — pattern corrected, line cleared, QC approved new pattern, hold released same shift at 19:01.

food_safety.title: Tape found inside S3 decorator melting tank
food_safety.summary: Piece of adhesive tape discovered inside decorator melting tank during production; line paused, tape removed with long tool, oil flush performed, QC inspected and cleared.
food_safety.status: Resolved — tape removed at 14:47, oil flush completed, QC inspection clear, production resumed.

food_safety.title: Glycol leak into ML1 depositor hopper
food_safety.summary: Glycol leaked into hopper during connection installation; line paused, hopper scraped and purged, QA inspected with no signs of glycol after purge.
food_safety.status: Resolved — purge completed at 00:32, QA inspection clear, no glycol detected.

food_safety.title: Grease found on ML1 chocolate bars
food_safety.summary: Two chocolate bars found with grease during line inspection; source under investigation, product isolated.
food_safety.status: Investigation ongoing — two pieces isolated, source not yet identified, line continues with monitoring.

food_safety.title: Corner board used on S3 MM conveyor cover
food_safety.summary: Employees observed using corner board to push product through MM 3-5 conveyor cover when plugged; creates contamination risk if board sheds material into product zone.
food_safety.status: Open — coaching requested for operators; no product hold initiated.

food_safety.title: Dark substance from S2 melting tank shaft
food_safety.summary: Dark-colored substance observed leaking from melting tank shaft into chocolate at 01:20; shaft cleaned immediately, maintenance inspected and believes substance is chocolate (not lubricant) as equipment uses clear oil.
food_safety.status: Open — shaft cleaned, maintenance assessment complete, line monitoring continues through shift.

quality.title: S3 metal detector rejecting every second
quality.summary: Metal detector rejecting items continuously; mechanics called to resolve malfunction.
quality.status: Resolved — mechanics repaired issue, line resumed normal operation.

sanitation.title: DFP sanitizer concentration incorrect
sanitation.summary: Dishwasher foaming product (DFP) found not concentrated correctly — very high; team directed to mix by hand following label directions until tech arrives; three 5-gallon buckets pre-mixed correctly by sanitation lead.
sanitation.status: Resolved — correct pre-mixed DFP staged for wash room, team notified to use as-is at 16:49.

opportunities.text: Consider adding decorator tank and hopper visual inspection to pre-start checklist — based on today's tape-in-tank event on S3 and corner-board contamination risk on MM conveyor.
Verify DFP dilution system or add concentration check to sanitation startup — today's very-high concentration required manual intervention and pre-mixing by supervisor.
Review glycol connection design on ML1 depositor — today's leak during install suggests quick-disconnect or different fitting may reduce contamination risk during maintenance.
Investigate grease source on ML1 chocolate line — two pieces found today; if equipment-related, add lubrication points to pre-shift inspection to catch before product contact.
